topic: Explain insertion sort like sorting playing cards
title: Insertion Sort, Card by Card

scenes.narration: Insertion sort works like sorting cards in your hand. The left part is always sorted. Each step takes the next value and slides it left past every larger value.
scenes.caption: Slide each card into place

scenes.narration: The first card, 5, is sorted on its own. The key 2 is smaller, so 5 shifts right and 2 goes in front.
scenes.caption: insert 2

scenes.narration: The key 4 is smaller than 5 but larger than 2, so 5 shifts right and 4 drops in between.
scenes.caption: insert 4

scenes.narration: The key 6 is larger than everything sorted so far, so nothing shifts. The sorted part is 2, 4, 5, 6.
scenes.caption: insert 6

scenes.narration: The key 1 is the smallest yet. All 4 sorted values shift right, and 1 goes to the very front.
scenes.caption: insert 1

scenes.narration: The last key 3 slides past 6, 5 and 4, and stops after 2. The array is sorted.
scenes.caption: insert 3

scenes.narration: Insertion sort did very little work for 6, which was already in place, and the most for 1. That is why it shines on small or nearly sorted data.
scenes.caption: Summary
points: Grow a sorted part on the left
Shift larger values right, drop the key in the gap
Fast on nearly sorted input, O(n squared) at worst

quiz.question: Insertion sort inserts one key into 3, 1, 2. What is the array afterwards?
quiz.explanation: The key 1 slides in front of 3; 2 has not been inserted yet.

quiz.question: Insertion sort runs two steps on 4, 5, 1. How many values shift in the second step?
quiz.explanation: The key 1 is smaller than both 4 and 5, so 2 values shift.
